'''Master Forn''' was a member in the [[Committee for Renewal]], a secret organization composed of ten [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and companies who wanted to rid their colony of the [[Stalton Syndicate]] and hired a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
